summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily purchases under its buy-back announced 28 October 2026. On 3 November 2026 it bought 170,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$12.7142 (range US$12.6060–12.8540) and 600,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$134.2929 (range HK$133.9000–134.7000), all for cancellation. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 3,077,600 shares for approximately US$52.9m, executed through Goldman Sachs International. Shares repurchased on UK venues are cancelled promptly, leaving 17,134,343,491 shares and voting rights with no treasury shares; HK cancellations lag, prompting a further total-voting-rights announcement. Watch the daily execution pace against the programme authorisation and any HK cancellation disclosure timing.
